events.title: Demo page is live!
events.summary: Hello adventurers, The demo page for Path of the Retired Adventurer is live! You can find it here: Excited to bring the demo to the public. I'm currently working on polishing the UI and refining contents for the demo. These includes: - More items to craft and equip - More affixes to roll - Updated trait and skill systems to build your adventurers Hoping to see you all soon! Cheers, Nightfeather Studio

events.summary: Hello adventurers, Thank you old friends and new ones for the support so far. The store page has been live for little over a week and has been growing (slowly) organically over the week. I'm currently working more marketing push and finishing the demo.
